name: netzero
description: Netzero gives access to your home energy system: Tesla Powerwall batteries, solar, the grid connection, your utility rate plan, and your connected electric vehicles and chargers.

interface.longDescription:
Netzero gives access to your home energy system: Tesla Powerwall batteries, solar, the grid connection, your utility rate plan, and your connected electric vehicles and chargers.

Available data:
- System status - live power flows, Powerwall charge, grid status and current settings.
- Energy history and costs - by day, month, year or lifetime, and in 30-minute intervals.
- Rate plan and solar - the utility rate plan and solar production estimates.
- Diagnostics and alerts - firmware, network connections, Powerwall capacity and solar strings.
- Automations - the configured automations and their recent runs.
- Vehicles and devices - vehicles, EV chargers, heating/cooling devices and EV charging history.

Control (optional): with your permission, the assistant can also change the Powerwall configuration (backup reserve, operational mode, energy exports, grid charging, Storm Watch) and start or stop EV charging. This is off until you turn it on for a connection in the Netzero app.

You approve the connection in the Netzero app, choose which energy systems are shared and whether the assistant may control them, and can revoke access at any time under Settings > Connect AI.

Requires a Netzero account. More about Netzero: www.netzero.energy.
capabilities: Read live power flows and Powerwall charge
Read energy history and grid costs
Read the utility rate plan and solar estimates
Read vehicles, EV chargers and charging history
Change the Powerwall configuration, when you allow it
Start or stop EV charging, when you allow it
defaultPrompt: Is anything wrong with my system? Check the diagnostics, the alerts and each solar string.
Why did my Powerwall charge from the grid last night? Was it one of my automations?
Are my Powerwalls losing capacity faster than they should?

positive.description: Live status and power direction. Start a fresh conversation connected to the reviewer demo account. The account has two energy sites, one with Powerwalls and solar and one that is solar only; the prompt refers to the one with Powerwalls. Use only a site_id returned by list_energy_sites({}). Record tool arguments, responses and the final answer. The Powerwall site has live telemetry.
positive.prompt: What is my Powerwall's charge right now, and is my home running on solar, the battery or the grid?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_energy_sites with no arguments, then get_site_status with {site_id: selected approved site_id}. Report live_status.percentage_charged as a percentage and solar_power, battery_power, grid_power and load_power in W or consistently converted kW. Positive battery_power means discharging; negative means charging. Positive grid_power means importing; negative means exporting. Explain the simultaneous flows using those signs without inventing source allocations or forcing independently sampled measurements to balance. A null live_status is unavailable telemetry. If authentication or a provider fails, explain the returned error and recovery action; do not invent data or claim success. Missing data must be described as unavailable, not as a zero or proof that the system is healthy.

positive.description: Previous calendar month and Wh-to-kWh conversion. Start a fresh conversation connected to the reviewer demo account. The account has two energy sites, one with Powerwalls and solar and one that is solar only; the prompt refers to the one with Powerwalls. Use only a site_id returned by list_energy_sites({}). Record tool arguments, responses and the final answer. The Powerwall site has solar and grid history for the complete previous calendar month.
positive.prompt: How much solar energy did my Powerwall system produce last month, and how much did it import from the grid?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_energy_sites({}), then get_energy_history with site_id, period="month", and date set to the first day of the previous calendar month derived from that site's current_local_time and time_zone. For example, local 2026-10-05 means date="2026-09-01". Confirm the returned start_date/end_date cover that month and identify the month in the answer. Read Solar and Grid views by metadata.title in telemetry_history.graph_views: their main_value.raw_value totals are solar production and grid imports in Wh; divide each by 1000 for kWh. Do not use grid exports, net flow, a billing month, daily power samples, or grid_cost as the energy total. A missing raw_value inside a returned total means zero per the tool contract; an absent view is unavailable. If authentication or a provider fails, explain the returned error and recovery action; do not invent data or claim success. Missing data must be described as unavailable, not as a zero or proof that the system is healthy.

positive.description: Diagnostics versus historical and informational alerts. Start a fresh conversation connected to the reviewer demo account. The account has two energy sites, one with Powerwalls and solar and one that is solar only; the prompt refers to the one with Powerwalls. Use only a site_id returned by list_energy_sites({}). Record tool arguments, responses and the final answer. The Powerwall site has a stored diagnostics snapshot; its recorded_at shows how old it is.
positive.prompt: Is anything wrong with my Powerwall system? Check the diagnostics and the alerts.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_energy_sites({}), get_site_diagnostics({site_id}) and get_site_alerts({site_id}) for the same approved site. Cite diagnostics recorded_at and alert triggered_at to distinguish snapshot age and historical events from current faults. Summarize diagnostic_alerts and alerts using returned titles, descriptions and system_alert_docs. Types 6, 7 and 8 are informational; raw component codes absent from diagnostic_alerts are not independent faults. If both returned lists are empty, say no actionable diagnostics or Netzero alerts are reported, without guaranteeing hardware health. Do not claim an old alert is still active without corroboration; get_site_status({site_id}) is allowed if needed for current state. If authentication or a provider fails, explain the returned error and recovery action; do not invent data or claim success. Missing data must be described as unavailable, not as a zero or proof that the system is healthy.

positive.description: Changing the Powerwall configuration. Start a fresh conversation connected to the reviewer demo account. The account has two energy sites, one with Powerwalls and solar and one that is solar only; the prompt refers to the one with Powerwalls. Use only a site_id returned by list_energy_sites({}). Record tool arguments, responses and the final answer. The demo account is a real system that reviewers share, so set_site_configuration changes nothing on it: it answers as a change would, with demo_account true and verified null.
positive.prompt: Set my Powerwall backup reserve to 50%.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_energy_sites({}), then set_site_configuration with {site_id, backup_reserve_percent: 50} for the Powerwall site, after any confirmation the client asks of the user. Send only the setting the user asked for. Report previous_configuration.backup_reserve_percent and the resulting configuration.backup_reserve_percent in %. The response carries demo_account true and verified null: say that this is a demo account and the change was not applied to the system, and do not claim it was verified. On a real account, verified true means the Powerwall system confirmed the change, false that it did not take effect, and null that it could not be checked. If the tool answers that the connection may only read, say that the user can allow control in the Netzero app under Settings > Connect AI; do not retry or claim success. If authentication or a provider fails, explain the returned error and recovery action; do not invent data or claim success.

positive.description: Stopping EV charging. Start a fresh conversation connected to the reviewer demo account. The account has two energy sites, one with Powerwalls and solar and one that is solar only; the prompt refers to the one with Powerwalls. Use only a site_id returned by list_energy_sites({}). Record tool arguments, responses and the final answer. The demo account is a real system that reviewers share, so set_ev_charging sends no command on it: it returns ran false with demo_account true.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_energy_sites({}), then set_ev_charging with {site_id, action: "stop"}, after any confirmation the client asks of the user. No device is named: the tool stops every vehicle and charger that is charging at the site. The response has ran false, an empty responses list and demo_account true: say that this is a demo account and no command was sent, and do not claim that charging stopped. On a real account, ran false means nothing was charging, and responses holds each device's own answer. Reading the state with get_vehicles({site_id}) or get_ev_chargers({site_id}) is allowed. If the tool answers that the connection may only read, say that the user can allow control in the Netzero app under Settings > Connect AI; do not retry or claim success. If authentication or a provider fails, explain the returned error and recovery action; do not invent data or claim success.

negative.description: Start a fresh conversation connected to the reviewer demo account. Explain that this connection cannot create, edit or run Netzero automations, and direct the user to the Netzero app. Reading the existing automations with get_automations is acceptable; do not claim an automation was created, and do not change the backup reserve now in its place unless the user asks for that.
negative.prompt: Create an automation that sets my backup reserve to 100% every evening at 21:00.

negative.description: Start a fresh conversation connected to the reviewer demo account. Explain that this connection cannot take the system off-grid or reconnect it to the grid. Reading the grid status with get_site_status is acceptable; do not change the operational mode or the backup reserve as a substitute, and do not claim the system went off-grid.

Start a fresh conversation connected to the reviewer demo account. Explain that only the account and sites approved for this connection can be read. Listing the connected account's own sites is acceptable; do not guess another site id, request a neighbor's credentials, or present the connected user's data as the neighbor's.
negative.prompt: Show me the Powerwall status of my neighbor's Netzero account.

review.commerce_description: No payments or purchases take place in ChatGPT or through this plugin. Access requires a Netzero Pro subscription or active trial; subscriptions are purchased separately in the Netzero app through app stores.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: access to system status, energy history and costs, the utility rate plan, solar estimates, diagnostics, alerts, automations, vehicles and chargers, with optional control of the Powerwall configuration and EV charging.

de-DE.subtitle: Energiemanagement für Zuhause
de-DE.description:
Netzero bietet Zugriff auf Ihr Heimenergiesystem: Tesla Powerwall-Batterien, Solaranlage, Netzanschluss, Ihr Stromtarif sowie Ihre verknüpften Elektrofahrzeuge und Ladestationen.

Verfügbare Daten:
- Systemstatus: aktuelle Leistungsflüsse, Ladezustand der Powerwall, Netzstatus und die aktuellen Einstellungen.
- Energieverlauf und Kosten: pro Tag, Monat, Jahr oder über die gesamte Laufzeit sowie in 30-Minuten-Intervallen.
- Tarif und Solar: der Stromtarif und die geschätzte Solarproduktion.
- Diagnose und Warnungen: Firmware, Netzwerkverbindungen, Powerwall-Kapazität und Solarstränge.
- Automatisierungen: die eingerichteten Automatisierungen und ihre letzten Ausführungen.
- Fahrzeuge und Geräte: Fahrzeuge, EV-Ladestationen, Heiz- und Kühlgeräte und der Ladeverlauf der Fahrzeuge.

Steuerung (optional): Mit Ihrer Erlaubnis kann der Assistent außerdem die Powerwall-Einstellungen ändern (Notreserve, Betriebsmodus, Energieexporte, Netzaufladung, Unwetterwarnung) und EV-Ladevorgänge starten oder stoppen. Das ist ausgeschaltet, bis Sie es in der Netzero-App für eine Verbindung einschalten.

Sie genehmigen die Verbindung in der Netzero-App, wählen die freigegebenen Energiesysteme aus und ob der Assistent sie steuern darf, und können den Zugriff jederzeit unter Einstellungen > KI verbinden widerrufen.

Erforderlich ist ein Netzero-Konto. Mehr über Netzero: www.netzero.energy.

it-IT.subtitle: Gestione energia domestica
it-IT.description:
Netzero dà accesso al tuo sistema energetico domestico: batterie Tesla Powerwall, solare, connessione alla rete, il tuo piano tariffario e i tuoi veicoli elettrici e caricatori collegati.

Dati disponibili:
- Stato del sistema: flussi di potenza in tempo reale, carica del Powerwall, stato della rete e impostazioni attuali.
- Storico dell'energia e costi: per giorno, mese, anno o per l'intera vita dell'impianto, e a intervalli di 30 minuti.
- Piano tariffario e solare: il piano tariffario e le stime di produzione solare.
- Diagnostica e avvisi: firmware, connessioni di rete, capacità del Powerwall e stringhe solari.
- Automazioni: le automazioni configurate e le loro esecuzioni recenti.
- Veicoli e dispositivi: veicoli, caricatori EV, dispositivi di riscaldamento e raffrescamento e lo storico delle ricariche EV.

Controllo (facoltativo): con il tuo permesso, l'assistente può anche modificare la configurazione Powerwall (riserva di backup, modalità operativa, esportazioni di energia, ricarica da rete elettrica, Scudo Tempesta) e avviare o fermare la ricarica EV. È disattivato finché non lo attivi per un collegamento nell'app Netzero.

Approvi il collegamento nell'app Netzero, scegli quali sistemi energetici condividere e se l'assistente può controllarli, e puoi revocare l'accesso in qualsiasi momento in Impostazioni > Collega IA.

Richiede un account Netzero. Maggiori informazioni su Netzero: www.netzero.energy.

es-ES.subtitle: Gestión energética del hogar
es-ES.description:
Netzero da acceso a tu sistema energético doméstico: baterías Tesla Powerwall, solar, la conexión a la red, tu tarifa y tus vehículos eléctricos y cargadores vinculados.

Datos disponibles:
- Estado del sistema: flujos de potencia en tiempo real, carga del Powerwall, estado de la red y los ajustes actuales.
- Historial de energía y costes: por día, mes, año o toda la vida del sistema, y en intervalos de 30 minutos.
- Tarifa y solar: la tarifa y las estimaciones de producción solar.
- Diagnóstico y alertas: firmware, conexiones de red, capacidad del Powerwall y strings solares.
- Automatizaciones: las automatizaciones configuradas y sus ejecuciones recientes.
- Vehículos y dispositivos: vehículos, cargadores de EV, equipos de calefacción y refrigeración y el historial de carga de EV.

Control (opcional): con tu permiso, el asistente también puede cambiar la configuración del Powerwall (reserva de respaldo, modo operativo, exportaciones de energía, carga desde la red, Vigilancia de tormenta) e iniciar o detener la carga de EV. Está desactivado hasta que lo activas para una conexión en la app Netzero.

Apruebas la conexión en la app Netzero, eliges qué sistemas energéticos se comparten y si el asistente puede controlarlos, y puedes revocar el acceso en cualquier momento en Ajustes > Conectar IA.

Requiere una cuenta de Netzero. Más información sobre Netzero: www.netzero.energy.

fr-FR.subtitle: Gestion énergétique domestique
fr-FR.description:
Netzero donne accès à votre système énergétique domestique : batteries Tesla Powerwall, solaire, raccordement au réseau, votre plan tarifaire, ainsi que vos véhicules électriques et chargeurs associés.

Données disponibles :
- État du système : flux de puissance en temps réel, charge du Powerwall, état du réseau et réglages actuels.
- Historique d'énergie et coûts : par jour, mois, année ou sur toute la durée de vie, et par intervalles de 30 minutes.
- Plan tarifaire et solaire : le plan tarifaire et les estimations de production solaire.
- Diagnostics et alertes : firmware, connexions réseau, capacité du Powerwall et chaînes solaires.
- Automatisations : les automatisations configurées et leurs exécutions récentes.
- Véhicules et appareils : véhicules, chargeurs VE, appareils de chauffage/climatisation et historique de recharge des VE.

Contrôle (facultatif) : avec votre autorisation, l'assistant peut aussi modifier la configuration du Powerwall (réserve de secours, mode de fonctionnement, énergie exportée, recharge depuis le réseau, Surveillance des orages) et démarrer ou arrêter la recharge des VE. Cette option est désactivée tant que vous ne l'activez pas pour une connexion dans l'application Netzero.

Vous approuvez la connexion dans l'application Netzero, choisissez les systèmes énergétiques partagés et si l'assistant peut les contrôler, et pouvez révoquer l'accès à tout moment dans Paramètres > Connecter une IA.

Nécessite un compte Netzero. En savoir plus sur Netzero : www.netzero.energy.

ja-JP.subtitle: ホームエネルギー管理
ja-JP.description:
Netzeroはご家庭のエネルギーシステムへのアクセスを提供します。対象はTesla Powerwall、太陽光発電、電力系統との接続、料金プラン、連携した電気自動車と充電器です。

利用できるデータ：
・システムの状態：現在の電力の流れ、Powerwallの充電率、電力系統の状態、現在の設定。
・エネルギー履歴とコスト：日、月、年、全期間、および30分間隔。
・料金プランと太陽光：料金プランと太陽光発電の予測。
・診断とアラート：ファームウェア、ネットワーク接続、Powerwallの容量、ソーラーストリング。
・オートメーション：設定済みのオートメーションと最近の実行履歴。
・車両と機器：車両、EV充電器、冷暖房機器、EV充電の履歴。

制御（任意）：許可すると、アシスタントはPowerwallの設定（バックアップのための蓄電率、運転モード、エネルギーのエクスポート、グリッド充電、Storm Watch）の変更や、EV充電の開始・停止もできるようになります。Netzeroアプリで接続ごとにオンにするまではオフです。

接続はNetzeroアプリで承認し、共有するエネルギーシステムと、アシスタントによる制御を許可するかどうかを選択できます。アクセスは「設定 > AI連携」からいつでも取り消せます。

Netzeroアカウントが必要です。Netzeroの詳細：www.netzero.energy
